sql_query.query: SELECT a.id, a.actor_id, u.name AS actor_name, a.type, a.message, a.metadata, a.created_at FROM _activity a LEFT JOIN _users u ON u.id = a.actor_id WHERE a.circle_id = $1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM _memberships m WHERE m.circle_id = $1 AND m.user_id = $2) ORDER BY a.created_at DESC LIMIT 100
